scientific_integrity: A proof based on positive Gram inversion, affine reproducing kernel, exact sign integration and convexity covers all positive edge masses; finite rational tests corroborate rather than replace it. Publication novelty is qualified by known source-access limitations.
scientific_limitations: One affine finite element per edge of a single finite star, real signals, positive constant density on each edge, and no point masses. Nothing is proved for multiple junctions, variable edgewise density, higher degree or boundary-constrained splines. Older specialist treatments might include an equivalent formula.
title: Sharp \(L^\infty\) stability of affine least-squares projection on weighted metric stars
